# qualtive_enquiry (Resource)

A Qualtive enquiry: the form feedback entries are collected through, addressed by its container and slug.

Creating fails if the slug is already taken in the container; import the existing enquiry instead. Deleting is permanent: the enquiry is removed, but its feedback entries are kept.

~> The server's slug check isn't atomic. Apply with `-parallelism=1` so that two creates with the same slug can't both succeed.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "qualtive_enquiry" "contact" {
  container    = "acme"
  workspace_id = 17
  slug         = "contact"
  name = {
    en = "Contact us"
    sv = "Kontakta oss"
  }

  pages = jsonencode([{
    id = 1
    content = [
      { type = "title", id = 1, text = { en = "How can we help?", sv = "Hur kan vi hjälpa till?" } },
      { type = "text", id = 2, storageTarget = { type = "text" } },
      { type = "contactDetails", id = 3, title = { en = "Your email", sv = "Din e-post" } },
    ]
  }])

  submitted_pages = jsonencode([{
    id         = 1
    conditions = []
    content    = [{ type = "title", id = 1, text = { en = "Thanks, we'll be in touch!", sv = "Tack, vi hör av oss!" } }]
  }])
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `container` (String) ID of the container (the company account) the enquiry belongs to. Changing it creates a new enquiry.
- `name` (Map of String) Name of the enquiry by language code, for example `{ en = "Contact us" }`. Use `*` for the fallback language.
- `pages` (String) JSON array of pages shown to the feedback poster, in the Admin API format. Use `jsonencode()`. Each page and content item needs an `id` that is unique within its page and stays stable between applies.
- `slug` (String) URL slug of the enquiry, unique within the container. Lowercase letters, digits and `-`. Changing it renames the enquiry in place; the old slug keeps resolving for feedback posters.
- `workspace_id` (Number) ID of the workspace the enquiry lives in. Changing it moves the enquiry.

### Optional

- `category_id` (Number) ID of the category the enquiry is filed under.
- `is_user_contact_details_required` (Boolean) Whether feedback posters must leave contact details. Defaults to `false`.
- `submitted_pages` (String) JSON array of pages shown after the feedback is submitted, in the Admin API format. Defaults to `[]`, which shows Qualtive's built-in thank-you page.
- `theme` (String) JSON theme object in the Admin API format. Defaults to the predefined default background and font with rounded corners.

### Read-Only

- `has_draft` (Boolean) Whether someone has unpublished edits to the enquiry in the admin UI. The provider never touches drafts.
- `id` (String) Server-assigned numeric ID of the enquiry.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `id` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = qualtive_enquiry.contact
  id = "acme/contact"
}
```

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Enquiries are imported by <container>/<slug>.
tofu import qualtive_enquiry.contact acme/contact
```
